caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric, bordered by a blue stitched edge, displayed against a light cream background. The interior of the fabric is divided into a large grid of small squares, each square containing a unique motif or pattern. The motifs are primarily floral or geometric in design, drawn in blue ink or thread. In several squares, simple straight lines, leaves, flowers, and symmetrical arrangements can be seen. Some central squares contain larger, more detailed designs, including tulip-shaped flowers and various symmetrical arrangements of petals and leaves. Towards the middle, there is a section with text: "S.A.D. d. 6. A. 178," written in blue within a grid square. The composition is highly organized, with every square filled and separated by horizontal and vertical blue grid lines. The entire image has a blue and cream color palette.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
